On acceptance replace buffer0 with compressed bytes, move all remaining original buffers unchanged, preserve num_values and store rewritten chunk sizes. Wrap selected CompressionConfig around the original encoding using ProtobufUtils21::wrapped; descriptor conversion may error after compression. Retains selected optional level rather than runtime-normalized codec config. Page input, compressed scratch and cloned metadata coexist during work; no strict allocation cap.
